_about: Simple meals (owner request, Nov 11 2026): everyday combinations of the cheapest staples (rice, beans, eggs, oats, tortillas, bread, bananas, avocado), so a tight budget can still give a different meal most days from the same few foods. Same format as seed-recipes.json (a standard serving of each food); ids 2001+. Written for Make It Stretch; translations in public/i18n/data/<lang>.json under recipes.

recipes.title: Egg, Rice and Avocado Bowl
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice. Fry or scramble the eggs. Serve the eggs over the rice with sliced avocado and a pinch of salt.

recipes.title: Rice and Beans with a Fried Egg
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice and warm the beans with a little salt. Fry the eggs in a little oil and serve them on top of the rice and beans.

recipes.title: Bean and Avocado Tacos
recipes.instructions: Warm the beans with a little salt and mash some of them. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with beans and sliced avocado.

recipes.title: Egg Tacos
recipes.instructions: Scramble the eggs in a little oil with a pinch of salt. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan and fill with the eggs.

recipes.title: Bean and Rice Burritos
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice and warm the beans with a little salt. Warm the tortillas, fill with rice and beans and roll up.

recipes.title: Potato and Bean Burritos
recipes.instructions: Dice the potatoes and fry them in a little oil until soft and golden. Warm the beans. Fill warm tortillas with potatoes and beans and roll up.

recipes.title: Beans on Toast
recipes.instructions: Warm the beans with a little salt and mash them lightly. Toast the bread and spoon the beans on top.

recipes.title: French Toast
recipes.instructions: Beat the eggs with the milk and a pinch of cinnamon. Dip each slice of bread and fry in a little oil until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Egg
recipes.instructions: Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt and spread it on the toast. Top with a fried or boiled egg.

recipes.title: Garlic Fried Rice
recipes.instructions: Cook the rice ahead (day-old rice is best). Fry chopped garlic in a little oil, add the rice and a pinch of salt, and stir until hot and a little crispy.

recipes.title: Pasta and Beans with Garlic
recipes.instructions: Cook the pasta and save a little of the water. Fry chopped garlic in a little oil, add the beans and a splash of the pasta water, then stir in the pasta.

recipes.title: Noodles with Egg and Soy Sauce
recipes.instructions: Cook the noodles and drain. Scramble the eggs in a little oil, add the noodles and a splash of soy sauce, and toss until hot.

recipes.title: Sweet Rice with Banana
recipes.instructions: Simmer cooked rice in a little water with a pinch of cinnamon until soft and thick. Top with sliced banana.

recipes.title: Grits with Banana
recipes.instructions: Cook the cornmeal in salted water, stirring, until thick. Top with sliced banana and a pinch of cinnamon.

recipes.title: Savory Grits with Egg
recipes.instructions: Cook the cornmeal in salted water, stirring, until thick. Top each bowl with a fried or soft-boiled egg.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Pancakes
recipes.instructions: Mash the banana, then mix in the eggs and oats. Cook spoonfuls in a little oil over medium heat until golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Oatmeal
recipes.instructions: Cook the oats in water with a pinch of salt. Stir in a spoon of peanut butter.

recipes.title: Savory Oats with Egg
recipes.instructions: Cook the oats in water with salt instead of sugar. Top each bowl with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Baked Potato with Egg
recipes.instructions: Bake or microwave the potatoes until soft. Split them open, add a little oil and salt, and top with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Lentils and Rice with Egg
recipes.instructions: Simmer the lentils in salted water until soft. Cook the rice. Serve the lentils over the rice with a fried or boiled egg.

recipes.title: Cabbage and Bean Soup
recipes.instructions: Simmer chopped cabbage in salted water until soft. Add the beans and a little of their liquid and heat through.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Tortilla
recipes.instructions: Spread peanut butter on a tortilla, add sliced banana and roll it up.
